correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all n(n−1) rooted-path maximal strong facets by removing the last critical cycle vertex, obtaining two adjacent unused edges and a single + to − sign block. For any reflection s_a, fixed barycentric coordinates give the incidence-orbit complex, no fixed individual incidence. Orbit types A/B form individually full simplices with m−1 or m−2 vertices; opposing types give forbidden alternating signs or use both orientations of one edge. Reproduced the complete orbit complex independently for all 89 odd/even reflection conjugacy instances 6≤n≤64; all are two disjoint simplices with the stated dimensions. The all-n result rests on the explicit sign-block/endpoint argument, not the 89 finite tests; reduced Lefschetz=χ(fixed)−1=1.
